d2_archive.name: Strategy_S9_check_for_trivial_cases
d2_archive.instruction: Consider special cases where the equation is simpler, such as when all variables are zero.

d2_archive.name: S2_complexity_reduction

d2_archive.name: S3_guess_and_check
